[[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] | followed by = [[Battle of Turai's Procession]] | map = [[File:Total Corruption map.jpg]] }} The evil corruption has spread to the centaur's [[Ancestor Tree]], destroy the demons that are spawning from it and use the sacred roots to purify the area once more. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat 5...0 more ancestral sprouts to cleanse the Ancestor Tree. * See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward. ===Reward=== * 2,500 [[Experience]] * 200 [[Gold]] * 10 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]] * [[Kournan Coin]] ==Walkthrough== Defeat the 5 ancestral sprouts near the Ancestor Tree. They spawn one at a time and once a group is defeated, the next will appear. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Insect]]s *{{w}} 20 [[Infectious Dementia]] [[Plant]]s *{{r}} 24 [[Corrupted Root]] *{{mo}} 24 [[Ancestral Bud]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Mirza Veldrunner :''"Ancestors help us! Nightfall has begun! The Ancestor Tree, once full of the wisdom and power of the ancients is now evil's breeding ground! Vile demons spawn from her branches and fall to the earth like rotten fruit that poison our village. You must help us. Here, take these '''sacred roots'''. It is the sole uncorrupted limb. '''Purge''' these foul abominations from existence."'' {{offer dialog |accept = We shall save your tree. |decline = I killed my last houseplant. Gardening isn't my forte, you dig? |ask = There is little time left. Cleanse the evil from the '''Ancestor Tree''' using the '''sacred roots'''. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Mirza Veldrunner :''"The Ancestor Tree is in a weakened state, but I no longer detect a foreign presence. Your acts of bravery have cemented your legacy among our pride. Thank you."'' :''"There is little time to celebrate, however. Word travels that a terrible evil is headed our way from the north lands. Seek me when you are ready to continue."'' {{bug|Mirza Veldrunner doesn`t handle the "sacred roots" and there is no need of it.}} [[Category:Rewards Kournan Coin]] [[Category:Rewards Lightbringer points]]
